_about: Thai and Southeast Asian ghost stories: a spirit that stays because a wrong was never set right, and the old ways that can put it to rest. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.
